resources.string: Install, update, and back up your SourceTX transmitter
For a new or fully erased board
Set up a supported ESP32-S3 board with verified stable SourceTX firmware. The app checks the board before writing anything.
Download and verify the signed stable SourceTX release. An application update keeps compatible saved models and settings.
Configure CRSF UART, Status LED indicator, buzzer, and haptic feedback pins directly in transmitter NVS memory.
Save one model or all model slots
Save your current model or every configured model to a backup file. Backups are checked for corruption before they are saved.
Choose a SourceTX backup, verify it, and restore it to your transmitter. You will be warned before any model is overwritten.
